==Usage==
Use this template for issues of the ''[[Star Wars: The Official Chess Collection]]'' line by placing the following code down, replacing "issue number" with the information required.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>ChessCite|ISSUE NUMBER}}

This template, like the rest of the reference magazine citation templates, is built using [[Module:BaseCitation]]. See [[Module:BaseCitation/doc]] for relevant maintenance categories and help building new templates. 

==Example(s)==
====Code====
<nowiki>{{ChessCite|1}}</nowiki>
====Result====
{{ChessCite|1}}
